floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. The two published total columns are equal for 1 BR Type A and 2 BR Type B even though their component figures vary. The selector uses each printed total once. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 2 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. Selected photographs depict the structure under construction.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 6 and 10. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3312 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 11 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The two published total columns are equal for 1 BR Type A and 2 BR Type B even though their component figures vary. The selector uses each printed total once.
